text: Sorry, I could not reach Helm. Please try again in a moment.
situations: The Helm hub could not be reached for the whole turn.
The machine behind voice is down entirely: both speech probes fail.

text: My thinking side is offline right now.
situations: The model endpoint refused the connection: nothing is listening on that port.

text: That's taking longer than I expected. Try asking again.
situations: The model took longer than the turn budget allows.
A cold or queued model wait: the answer never arrived in time.

text: I'm still working on it. The answer will go to your phone.
situations: An escalation to the hub ran past its short waiting budget; the hub keeps working and can send the answer onward.

text: That didn't work. Try asking again.
situations: The model answered badly (a non-200 or unreadable reply), or the turn crashed outright.
A hub turn that was abandoned, or a hub that forgot the turn id.
The hub token or scope is wrong: a setup mistake - the log says so.
Tool refusals worded by the model, when the model itself then failed.

text: I'm handling a lot right now. Try again in a minute.
situations: The hub turned the request away as busy (HTTP 429): too many live turns at once.

text: Helm needs updating before I can answer by voice.
situations: An escalation came back with exactly this sentence: the hub software is too old to answer by voice yet.
The model (or the fallback endpoint) said nothing usable after its retry.
A house request was blocked by the success gate: no tool call ever carried it out.

text: My voice is not working right now. Try again in a moment.
situations: Played by the Home Assistant automation, never decided by the component.
A quiet end of listening with the hearing service failing its probe.
A dead turn where only one of the two speech engines answers its probe.

text: I got stuck. Please try again.
situations: Played by the automation when the satellite sits in processing for twenty seconds; the announcement itself cancels the hung run.
